__: matters most here: the glass wall before and after the blade opens it. Two
___: extra captures past the sheet walk the west stack, which is the quarter of
____: the level that has no unbreakable way into it.

____: * teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of a 22 px body on the tile's top-left, so her

___: and the one thing in the room that glows.

_: B — THE GLASS, SHUT. Ledge B is a one-way tread capped at row 24, so drop

___: goes where she is looking, and after a teleport she is looking wherever she
